meta.name: test-assumptions
meta.description: Challenge a proposed solution by identifying and testing consequential assumptions. Use when the brief feels too certain or discovery reveals contradictions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把看似确定的方案拆开,找出并验证它最要命的假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果方案看起来太顺、没人质疑,你想先挖出隐藏的风险
copy.tagline_en: Break a proposed solution apart and pressure-test its riskiest assumptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if the plan looks too certain and you want hidden risks surfaced first

howto.what: 它会挑出方案中影响重大的假设并逐条检验，产出检验结果；动手前先读取任务上下文契约与方法参考。若由 @fde 调用，则复用其已净化的信息包与范围，不重跑设置或已答过的问题。
howto.when: 当需求文档显得过于确定，或调研过程中出现矛盾时触发；若由 @fde 调用，则沿用其当前范围与已净化信息。

say.text: 帮我检验这个方案里最关键的假设
say.note: 会列出并逐条测试高风险假设

say.text: 这份需求写得太确定了，挑出它隐藏的假设
say.note: 先读方法参考，再给检验结果

say.text: 调研结果和方案有矛盾，测一下哪个假设错了
say.note: 保留未知项，区分验证与验收

howto.what_en: Claude identifies the consequential assumptions in a proposed solution and tests each one. It first reads the task context contract and method reference; under @fde it reuses the existing sanitized packet and scope.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the brief feels too certain, or when discovery reveals contradictions. Called by @fde, it keeps the current scope and packet.

say_en.text: Test the most consequential assumptions in this proposed solution.
say_en.note: Lists and tests the high-risk assumptions.

say_en.text: This brief reads as too certain - pull out its hidden assumptions.
say_en.note: Reads the method reference before reporting results.

say_en.text: Discovery contradicts the proposal; test which assumption is wrong.
say_en.note: Keeps unknowns open, separates verification from acceptance.
